delivery.brief: Native Arabic male narrator, friendly and knowledgeable technology explainer: curious, confident, approachable. Opening as a genuine question, brief pause, then explain as if to one friend. Moderate pace, short pauses between ideas, clear emphasis on contrasts. Acronyms as separate English letter names. No theatrical or newsreader delivery.
